summary: thurgadina/Dardek_Bladewright (quests.id 16673): disable the later-era warrior_pre script. Before: enabled, with a coffee hand-in (60289) and a three-item forge hand-in (60285, 60286, 60288) rewarding 60292. None of these IDs exist in data/items, so the quest can never be completed, and the script sends the player to Korbuk Brimblade in Dranik's Scar. After: a maintained modified-upstream override with -- enabled: false, the row enabled=0, and a post_kunark_missing_items ledger entry, the same pattern as sro/Dahdd_Jonne. The NPC and its spawn are unchanged. Validation: source review, check-proposal, npm test and npm run validate. Not runtime tested.
